scoring.unit: One question and one provided excerpt. Number nonempty lines from 1. Score a named value, definition or footnote only when the candidate center is the prespecified row itself.
scoring.positive: Report exact Hit@1 and Hit@3 over answerable questions, including contradictory claims. Top-k is row-level retrieval; columns, the answer and an editorial decision are not scored. Adjacent context, a header over the correct data and matching a different year do not count.
scoring.negative: Keep unanswered questions in a separate denominator. Report how many returned at least one candidate, and how many returned zero. A candidate is not a verdict. Zero results alone is not a measured correct human abstention.
scoring.freeze: Queries, rows, answers, source selection and scoring rule were fixed before executing either retrieval implementation.
